Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

This July, the focus of our update will be towards one of the latest Avengers, our Friendly Neighbourhood, Spider-Man! 

 

This is to help celebrate the release of Spider-Man: Far From Home film, so make sure to join us as a new story unfolds. 

 

Three new characters will be added in  this update, Hydro-Man, Molten Man, and Electro. We’ve also added 4 new uniforms for Spider-Man, Spider-Man 2099, and Mysterio.
10 more characters can realize their potential, so make sure to strengthen them after the update. Tier-3 for the Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Strange is now also available. 

 

We’ve also added a new Legendary Battle [Spider-Man: Far From Home] to the list of playable stories. 
Ease of use improvements have been made to Uru Enhancements for a more convenient way to strengthen them.
As well as introducing the new type of Enhance Uru,  Odin’s Blessing has been added. 
Together with new products to help the growth of your characters, removed Alliance Raid, and the Renewal of Alliance rewards.
Added Battle Training mode for World Event and some other contents have also been improved for everyone’s convenience.
 
▣ Added 3 New Characters
 
A group of villains threatening Spider-Man have arrived, each of them highly dangerous due to their ability to manipulate an element.

 

Electro, with his ability to manipulate electricity,
Molten Man, with the ability to manipulate magma.
And, Hydro-Man, with the ability to manipulate water.

 

  

 

 

* The Skill descriptions shown are based on Level 1.

 

▣ Added 4 New Uniforms


A few new uniforms have been added with the July update to give our featured characters some great new looks and skills.
 
Spider-Man [Spider-Man: Far From Home], Spider-Man [Spider-Man: Far From Home (Stealth Suit)], Mysterio [Spider-Man: Far From Home], Spider-Man 2099 [All-New, All-Different].

 

 

 

* The Uniform effects shown above are based on normal rank.
* 4 new uniforms will be on sale during the event period. You can check them out on the Marvel Universe menu and by going to the Uniform Room.
* Spider-Man [Spider-Man:  Far From Home], Spider-Man (Spider-Man: Far From Home (Stealth Suit)] are Synergy Uniforms, during the Uniform Discount Event, the Uniform Synergy discount will be applied. 
 

▣ Added 10 More Potential Awakened Characters
 
With the July update, the potential for Molten Man, Hydro-Man, Electro, Mysterio, Spider-Man 2099, Vulture, Sandman, Rhino, Kraven, and Lizard have been unlocked. You can now grow the mentioned characters up to Level 70.
 

 

▣ New Tier-3 Character Upgrade!
 
The Tier-3 upgrade is now available for the Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Strange. You will soon be able to see powerful magic and enhanced skills to match the title. 

 

 

 

 

▣ Added a New Legendary Battle [Spider-Man: Far From Home]

 

Enjoy a teaser of the MARVEL Cinematic Universe through MARVEL Future Fight.
Spider-Man’s new adventure has been added to the list of the Legendary Battle game mode. 

 

[Spider-Man: Far From Home] consists of 3 stages in total. Each stage will be led by a specific character with a specific skill set related to the story. You can earn additional rewards based on how well developed that specific characters is on your roster, including uniform bonuses if available. 

 

 

If you owned Mysterio below 6★, your Msyerio will rank up to 6★ immediately through entering the Stage ‘Wave of Venice’.

 

- There is also a chance for you to earn a powerful character whenever you enter a Legendary Battle stage depending on the theme.
 
<Spider-Man: Far From Home> allows you to upgrade to Extreme mode by purchasing the package. It is much more difficult than the Normal difficulty, but also contains special rewards when all challenges are accomplished. 

 

[Normal Mode Contents and Rewards]

 

 

 

[Extreme Mode content and Rewards]

 

 

 

- Extreme mode can be purchased via the pop-up window, in the Featured Shop within the Store, or by entering the Legendary Battle game mode and tapping on the Extreme difficulty.
* Once the Legendary Battle: Spider-Man: Far From Home Pack has been purchased, refunds will not be accepted.
* Extreme Mode rewards are given when the Extreme mission are completed, and not upon purchase.

 

[5/8 10:31 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/8 3:31 a.m. (PDT) added]

- Legendary Battle Extreme Mode will unlock immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary Battle Extreme Mode can be used continuously after purchase.

 

▣ Improved Uru Enhancement and Odin's Blessing added

 

Uru Enhancement to improve your Character Gears has been improved for more convenience! 
The new type of Enhanced Uru, Odin’s Blessing has been added.

1. Convert and Enhance Uru have been modified to become the Combine Uru function.

 

Other materials required for combining Uru’s have been removed and changed of balance. Now, you simply need 1 Uru as a material to combine for a greater Uru.

 

- You can combine Uru’s by using Urus of the same grade, regardless of type.
- Urus obtained from combining are randomly determined, unless both Urus are of the same Type.
- You can acquire different kinds of Urus from combining different type of Urus.
- Even when combining a Mythic Uru and/or Odin’s Blessing, the result will be random and will not guarantee another Odin’s Blessing.
* When combining Odin’s Blessings, you may receive a Mythic Uru as a result.

  
2. You can now use the Combine All button to combine your Urus by batches for your convenience.

 

 

3.  You can now sort your available Urus in the Equip Uru window. 

- You can also sort your Urus by color (type).

 

4. A new enhanced Odin's Blessing has been added. 

 

Odin's Blessing are obtainable by combining 6★ Urus, purchased from the Store, or as a reward from World Boss.

 

The new Odin's Blessing contains 2 options. Both of which increase when the Uru is Amplified. 

 

- You can equip up to 1 Odin’s Blessing Type per Gear.

 

5. Guide for the new Uru Combine system and missions within the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy have been added. 

 

 

6. Combining Uru achievements will be added instead of the existing Uru Enhance and Convert Uru.

 

 

7. Equipped Urus can be unequipped for a certain price. 

 

 

 

▣ Added Enchanted Uru Chest

 

Equip your character’s gears with Urus to increase their effectiveness in battle.
You can acquire various types of Urus from the Enchanted Uru Chest, including the new Odin’s Blessing as possible rewards. 

 

- The chance-up and probability of this package will be posted sometime in the official forum, so make sure to tune in.

- Click here to view the probability table for this chest.

 

▣ Removed Alliance Raid and the Renewal of Alliance Rewards
 
Streamlined the Alliance Arena to make Alliance growth more enjoyable.
With the removal of the existing Alliance Raid, the rewards can now be obtained via check-in
 
Aside from the Alliance Memento, Alliance Store XP, and Alliance XP previously given as Check-in rewards, you will now also receive Gold and an Alliance Chest.

 

You can obtain various useful items for growth through the Alliance Chest. You can even obtain an Enchanted Uru, the main reward of the chest.  

 

The tier of the Alliance Check-in Chest you will receive is based on the number of Alliance members who checked-in previously. 

 

- The Alliance check-in reward will be sent to your Inbox.

 

Additionally, we wanted to make the application process for an Alliance more convenient for new members. 
The following functions have been added in the approval window of joining an alliance.  

 

- Improved the sort function for level and last check-in
- Ability to check recent access history has been improved!

 

 ▣ Added Battle Training Mode in World Event

 

To help agents prepare for the coming battle against villains, a new system has been added in the World Event.

 

Battle Training Mode will allow agents to enter the training facilities, without any restrictions as long as the World Event game mode is up. Keep practicing and build a strategy for defeating the villains. 

 

- Battle Training Mode is only available while the World Event is active.
* After entering “Ready” you will no longer be able to select “Battle Training”. 


You can change the way you tackle the training mode.
Make sure to use your training to good use and enter the actual battle after your practice.

 

When the battle is over, you will be able to see your highest and total recorded scores.
Please note that training score will not give rewards.
 

 

 

▣Uniform Collection Spider-Man: Far From Home!

 

Celebrating the theme of [Spider-Man: Far From Home], a new Uniform Collection has been added to help you enjoy the new characters and uniforms.

 

You can enter the Uniform Collection and register a uniform once you meet the requirements.
Earn initial rewards for registering a uniform and get additional rewards for completing the Uniform Collection within the specific time period as a bonus.

 

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

1. Battleworld is only exposed during the event period. 

- If Battleworld is available, a “Available Now” button will show up.
- Previously, agents could enter Battleworld via Main Lobby > Enter > Arena tab. This has been changed to only the shortcut button in the Main Lobby whenever Battleworld is available. 
 

2. Crystals can also be used to upgrade your character's Gear along with the materials, once a gear is on +15 - +20.

 

- Crystals can not be used after reaching +21 on your character’s Gears upgrade!

 

3. Ultimates Character Packages can now be purchased through [Acquire/Upgrade Characters] - [Acquire Character] from in-game Store. 

 

- The normal Ultimate Packages were removed and special packages will now be available.

 

4. Tony Stark's Supply Chest has been improved to be purchaseable once a month.

 

- You can check the top right side of a package to know when you can repurchase the product.
* The Purchase limit is reset every 1st day of the month.

 

▣ Others Improvements


1. Psylocke’s [Disassembled] Uniform model has been reworked to match her comic counterpart more accurately. 


2. When clearing a stage, projectiles and other object effects have been modified.


3. Fixed the skill buttons when holding a skill will cause other skills not to activate when tapped. (Basic Attack, Active Skill, Ultimate Skill, Co-op Skill)


4. Falcon [Captain America: Winter Soldier], Hawkeye (Kate Bishop [MARVEL Now!], Character Tips have been edited.


5. The Wasps skill effects for WASP[MARVEL’S Ant-Man and the Wasp] and WASP (NADIA VAN DYNE) have been modified to represent a more accurate positioning.


6. Fixed an issue when Captain America uses “Heroic Fury”, his Tier-2 passive, “Hold The Line” was being activated more than once and “Hold the Line”’s effect duration was increased by 1 second. 


7. X-Men Growth Support Event Relay Battleworld rewards.
M’kraan Crystals/Phoenix Feather will be sent to the Inbox of those affected. 

 

8. Unrefined Uru can no longer be obtained from Story Mission Chapters 11 - 13.
In addition, leftover Unrefined Uru will be converted to their Gold equivalent from the Shop after the update. The Gold will be sent directly to the Inbox.


9. World Boss unlock challenges have been changed:
Quicksilver Normal Difficulty: Eliminate Ebony Maw (Normal) X 5 rewards -> Uru Rewards Changed to Gear Up Kit X 20
Cable Normal Difficulty: [ISO-8] Combine 15, 30, 50 times -> Uru Rewards Changed to Extreme Boost ISO-8
 

10. Existing S.H.I.E.L.D. Processor to develop 1★ - 4★ Enchanted Uru required Unrefined Uru as material, has been removed and changed to the following:
Gear Up Kit X 20, Phoenix Feather X 15, Dimension Debris X 20

Are you excited for the July update of MARVEL Future Fight? Make sure not to miss Spider-Man: Far From Home both in the theatres and in the game. 

 

Additionally, as promised, there will be a special announcement related to MARVEL’S Avengers: Endgame sometime in 3rd week of July. So, make sure to stay tuned. 

 

Thank you.
